kata.name: Command weak lens: undo drift — the inverse-law equation finds it, the conventional round-trip test finds it too
kata.series_verdict: pre-registered: Command has no proven equivalence in ploeh §6; the inverse-law lens is expected to buy zero unique detections (parity)

expected.detail: the weak lens is the pair after∘undo = before (eq0) and before∘redo = after (eq1); the seeded fault makes Command row 1 undo s2 to s2 instead of s1, breaking eq0 only. The scripted conventional test executes undo after do and asserts the pre-state, so the detection is parity.

commands: python3 prototype/weak_lens_set_baseline.py --assert  # exit 0: scripted conventional test matches the pre-registered detections
cargo run -q -p catherine-cli -- check fixtures/katas/weak-lens-set/command-fault-undo-drift.ct.json --json  # exit 3, 1 findings
cargo test -p catherine-ledger --test weak_lens_set_kata  # frozen evidence test

comparison.conventional_baseline: scripted Command test: for every command, after.undo = before and before.redo = after; covers both command rows

expressibility_gap.invariant: command history, queue order, and receiver dispatch
expressibility_gap.why: the before/after states are pre-declared in the instance; a missing undo registration or an incorrect dispatch to the receiver cannot be discovered by a static path equation

discrepancies: ploeh-grounding.md §6 lists these patterns as HYPOTHESIZED candidates, not proven equivalences; this slice records parity or a null result and does not upgrade any of them.
procedure: 1. control first: validate the near-floor control's empty unique set and killed verdict before any positive is read.
2. probe arm: cargo run -q -p catherine-cli -- check <fixture> --json; findings recorded verbatim.
3. baseline arm: python3 prototype/weak_lens_set_baseline.py --assert; detections are the pre-registered element names.
4. unique = probe elements - baseline elements; the element vocabulary is fixed in fixtures/katas/weak-lens-set/README.md.
5. verdict: empty unique with an expressible lens => killed (parity); an unexpressible lens with zero findings => killed with the gap recorded (null result).
